:::{#sol-null-gram-practice}

Each entry of $\matr{A}\vecf{x}$ is $x_1 + x_2$,
so $\matr{A}\vecf{x} = \vzero_3$ exactly when $x_2 = -x_1$,
and $\mathcal{N}(\matr{A}) = \operatorname{span}\cb{(1, -1)}$.
By @thm-null-gram,

$$
\mathcal{N}(\tp{\matr{A}}\matr{A}) = \operatorname{span}\cb{(1, -1)}.
$$

As a check, $\tp{\matr{A}}\matr{A} = \sbmat{3 & 3 \\ 3 & 3}$,
which sends $(1, -1)$ to $\vzero_2$.

:::
